assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: wide cinematic website hero background, 16:9 landscape.
Primary request: an atmospheric Australian coastal city waterfront at blue hour, understated contemporary low-rise commercial architecture reflected in still harbour water, distant buildings softly illuminated, viewed from the promenade.
Style: premium editorial architectural photography, authentic fine surface textures, realistic photographic detail, restrained cinematic grading.
Composition: panoramic wide photograph; calm dark navy negative space over water across the left half for white website text, buildings and subtle warm lights across the center-right; horizon at upper third. No people.
Lighting and palette: blue-hour ambient light, deep navy and slate blue, restrained teal reflections and warm amber window lights. Retain visible midtone details; do not make nearly black.
Constraints: no text, lettering, logos, watermark, collage or borders. Do not imitate a specific named building. One cohesive photograph.

Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: portrait 4:5 cinematic photograph for an About section in a professional Newcastle NSW portfolio.
Primary request: a sweeping Australian coastal headland and ocean outlook, sandstone rocks and coastal grass in foreground, a quiet walking path curving toward the ocean, headland horizon and ocean fading into subtle blue mist. No people.
Style: premium editorial landscape photograph, realistic fine detail, natural coastal textures, quiet and considered.
Composition: vertical 4:5 photograph, foreground path gently leads through lower center, coastal headland at middle, open ocean on right and atmospheric blue sky at top. A broad sense of perspective, uncluttered areas at top and bottom for small website captions.
Lighting and palette: dawn, soft directional warm light on sandstone, slate blue and muted teal ocean, subdued olive grass, restrained pale gold highlights. Clearly legible scenery in midtones, suitable for a dark cinematic site.
Constraints: no text, logos, watermark, borders or collage. Do not imply exact landmark identification. One photograph.

Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: wide cinematic 16:9 background photograph for an optics sales and marketing experience section.
Primary request: a premium unbranded outdoor binocular on a dark stone surface in a refined optics workshop, large coated optical glass objectives visible, precision machined matte charcoal body, subtle softly blurred workshop environment.
Style: highly realistic editorial product photography, crisp material textures and accurate physically plausible binocular design. No firearm, no riflescope, no people.
Composition: low camera angle, binocular occupies center-right near the middle of frame; left third has quiet defocused navy negative space for white web copy; subject still visible in center crop on mobile. Wide 16:9 landscape.
Lighting and palette: restrained studio side light, blue-gray and deep navy background, green-teal optical glass reflections, a fine warm amber rim light. Midtone readable detail, elegant and calm, not an advertisement poster.
Constraints: no text, lettering, logos, watermark, borders, collage, floating objects. One cohesive photograph.

Constraints: no text, logos, lettering, watermark, borders or collage, no real company branding, not a specific named building. One photograph.

Use case: photorealistic-natural

Primary request: a serene scholarly library interior with beautifully aligned shelves of hardback books, contemporary dark timber shelving, a quiet study table in the foreground, soft warm reading lights, tall windows admitting soft blue twilight.
Style: premium editorial interior photography, realistic book shapes and fine timber textures, thoughtfully composed, scholarly and restrained, no people.

Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: wide cinematic 16:9 landscape photograph for outdoor industry and contact sections of a professional portfolio.
Primary request: majestic rugged New Zealand style mountain ranges at dawn, layers of mountain silhouettes receding through blue mist, dark rocky alpine ridge in foreground, a distant peak catching soft first amber sunlight beneath a tranquil cloudy sky.
Style: premium fine art editorial landscape photography, realistic terrain and subtle atmospheric depth, quiet optimistic expansive mood.
Composition: wide 16:9 panorama with mountains at middle and lower half; main lit peak just right of center, left half softly misty and uncluttered for large white website copy; center crop remains compelling for portrait mobile use.
Lighting and palette: slate and navy blue mountain layers, very restrained teal haze, pale amber sunlight on a ridge and clouds. Natural believable atmosphere; sufficient midtone detail before dark website overlays.
Constraints: no people, buildings, text, logos, watermark, borders or collage. One cohesive photograph, no exaggerated fantasy mountains.
